episodes.title: Even for Kings
episodes.summary: A battle erupts between good and evil when a mysterious traveler embarks on a journey to Subternia. Teela seeks guidance from a trusted source.

episodes.title: Ascension
episodes.summary: A flashback sheds light on Adam's family history as he weighs a difficult decision — and Teela begins an important quest. A strange virus grips Eternos.

episodes.title: More Things in Heaven and Eternia
episodes.summary: With the Horde's evil plan in place, Skeletor learns the truth about his past. Duncan and Orko seek an old friend's help to enhance the Sword of Power.

episodes.title: The Dogs of War
episodes.summary: A conflicted Adam wrestles with regret as Man-At-Arms, Teela and other allies race to defend Eternia, erupting in a violent confrontation.

episodes.title: The Scepter and The Sword
episodes.summary: Magic and tech spark chaos in a climactic battle for Castle Grayskull. Can our heroes — and a selfless act — restore hope for Eternia's future?
